title: Bug lifecycle
summary: Reproduce, prioritize, fix, verify, release, and learn from unexpected behavior.
entryConditions: Expected and observed behavior can be described or evidence is available
steps: Capture impact, environment, and reproduction evidence
Triage severity, affected users, and workaround
Reproduce where practical and implement a focused correction within coding standards
Verify the correction and relevant regression risks
Communicate, release, and capture follow-up learning
